notes:
Quick summary: early-stage commercial product (IDE-centric) building an in-editor copilot with repo-aware retrieval. CTO emphasized "doesn't leave our AWS account" requirement for commercial tiers. Primary ask: embeddings for monorepo code, shallow chunking (2-4kb / logical unit), vector DB candidate comparison (FAISS vs Milvus vs Pinecone), and model pinning for deterministic completions.

Highlights from discovery call:
- Interested in low-latency streaming token-by-token (<50ms/token target for local dev loops) for autocompletion and code actions.
- Need per-repo and per-team namespace isolation + retention controls (30d vs 365d).
- Want automatic selection between compact quantized model for completions and larger model for code generation; must support version pinning per workspace.
- Security: SSO/SAML, customer KMS for key wrapping, audit logs for every query, and optional on-prem vector DB to satisfy a handful of enterprise beta customers.
- POC constraints: run on VPC with private inlet, ingest ~70 repositories (~50GB of code), evaluate recall at top-5 and end-to-end median latency under simulated IDE load.

AE notes (Jordan): "Good product, complex constraints. Need clear RBC (residency + backup) answer. CTO asked for a sample dataflow diagram and a cost estimate for 3 node private vector DB + Dedicated inference pool."

technical_requirements: Latency target: median completion latency <80ms end-to-end, per-token streaming <50ms when on Dedicated
Throughput: up to 120 concurrent dev sessions during peak hour; burst to 400
Chunking: function-level preferred, fallback to file-level for large files (2-4kb chunks recommended)
Embeddings: repo-scoped namespace + incremental indexing, 1536-d or 3072-d vectors depending on embedding model
Vector DB: ability to host in-customer VPC or support private managed instance; prefer FAISS/HNSW-like search w/ ANN + persistent KV for metadata
Model pinning: each workspace must be able to pin model version and quantization profile (e.g., redwood-code-2.1-quant)
poc_plan: 2-week controlled PoC: ingest 70 repos -> build embeddings in customer's VPC (private vector DB) -> run 2 retrieval configs (function-level, file-level) -> measure recall/top5 and latency under synthetic IDE traffic -> present report + recommended config and cost estimate.
